pages.text: Set it on a heat source (lit campfire, furnace or grill), toss in the ingredients, wait and serve with a bowl.$(br2)Empty hand: returns the last ingredient.

Guiso stew: potato, carrot, tomato, onion and raw beef. Full Belly, Comfort and a touch of Regeneration.$(br2)Locro: pumpkin, wheat, potato, onion, chorizo and beef. Full Belly, Nourishment and Resistance.
